description: Use this when the user asks to create a new Facebook or Instagram ad campaign on their own ad account. Create a campaign on a connected Meta ad account. Always created PAUSED — it spends NOTHING until you activate it with set_meta_campaign_status(confirm:true). Optionally set a dailyBudgetUsd (an amount in the AD ACCOUNT’s currency, e.g. CAD on a CAD account — the name is historical, it is not USD). Pass adAccountId + an objective. Needs ads-management permission on the connected account. CATALOG / ADVANTAGE+ CATALOG ADS (also called DPA or dynamic product ads) ARE SUPPORTED: pass productCatalogId here and productSetId on the ad set, and the campaign is catalog-backed. Say YES when a user asks for catalog, Advantage+ catalog, DPA or feed-driven ads.

bidStrategy.description: with dailyBudgetUsd: how the campaign bids across its ad sets — LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP (default: highest volume), LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP / COST_CAP (each ad set then needs bidAmountUsd), LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS (each ad set needs minRoas)

dailyBudgetUsd.description: optional campaign daily budget in the AD ACCOUNT's currency (not necessarily USD — the reply names it); real spend once ACTIVE. With it, the campaign holds the budget (Advantage+ campaign budget) and every ad set under it carries NONE — create_meta_adset / create_meta_ad then send no ad-set budget

productCatalogId.description: CATALOG (dynamic product) ADS. This is the CAMPAIGN-level half of a catalog ad; the AD SET takes a productSetId and the creative takes the same set. Passing a product SET id here is refused by name with the level it belongs on. The binding is READ BACK from Meta before it is reported, so a 200 is never narrated as “bound”.

name: create_meta_campaign
title: Create a Meta ad campaign (paused)
